name: @gusnips/oxlint
description: One oxlint config for a TypeScript repo, and one for a React repo. Rules go on top of it in the repo's own .oxlintrc.json.
author: Gustavo Salomé

scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run sync:docs
scripts.release:patch: bun pm version patch && bun publish --access public
scripts.release:minor: bun pm version minor && bun publish --access public
scripts.release:major: bun pm version major && bun publish --access public
